description: Use when an agent must turn its own HTML or Markdown into an image (social card, chart, table snapshot, preview) or capture a page as PNG. Input: GET ?url=, or POST JSON {html | markdown | url, width 320-1920, full_page}. Korean fonts included. Output: JSON fileBase64 (decode to the PNG), bytes, viewport. Bad input or daily cap refused before payment. Example: ?url=https://example.com/ Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

html.description: HTML to render (MCP argument or POST JSON; alternative to url/markdown)

markdown.description: Markdown to render (MCP argument or POST JSON; alternative to url/html)

url.description: Public http(s) page to render (GET). For html/markdown use POST JSON.

name: render_png
title: Render to image: HTML, Markdown or a web page to a PNG (cards, charts, previews)
